IV.description_en: An optional 128-bit (16-byte) hexadecimal value represented by a 32-character string, used with the key for encrypted data blocks. If you do not specify this value, MediaPackage creates a constant initialization vector (IV). Default value: empty. If specified, the value is passed through to the provider as a constant initialization vector

SystemIds.description_en:
The DRM system ID. The number of system IDs is determined by the protocol type used:
DASH: Up to two.
HLS: One.
HLS_CMAF: Up to two.
Only the following three DRM systems are supported: Apple FairPlay, Google Widevine, and Microsoft PlayReady. The corresponding system IDs are:
Apple FairPlay:
94ce86fb-07ff-4f43-adb8-93d2fa968ca2
Google Widevine:
edef8ba9-79d6-4ace-a3c8-27dcd51d21ed
Microsoft PlayReady:
9a04f079-9840-4286-ab92-e65be0885f95
